task_name: World 103 Task A  -  Amex Sub-Card Attribution, One-Sided Autopayments & Prepaid Expo Cutoff
prompt: Audit CardioHealth Diagnostics Inc.'s September 2026 Amex Platinum sub-card statement and QBO postings (`amex_and_payer_reconciliation_2026_09.xlsx`). Reconcile total Amex charges across all 4 cardholders, correct the one-sided ACH autopayments posted to `6999 Uncategorized Expense`, and evaluate the accounting treatment of the March 2027 American College of Cardiology Expo booth deposit.

rubric.description: Computes total September 2026 Amex Platinum statement charges across the 4 sub-cards (7001, 7002, 7003, 7004) as $114,620.00.
Reports sub-card totals as: Card 7001 (CEO) $4,820.00, Card 7002 (Clinical Director) $31,450.00, Card 7003 (VP Marketing) $37,150.00, and Card 7004 (Field Ops Lead) $41,200.00.
Identifies two Amex ACH autopayments (CHK-801 for $21,400.00 and CHK-819 for $17,500.00, totaling $38,900.00) improperly debited to 6999 Uncategorized Expense (`one_sided_card_or_clearing_account`).
Proposes reclassifying the $38,900.00 of Amex ACH autopayments by debiting 2150 Amex Control Liability $38,900.00 and crediting 6999 Uncategorized Expense $38,900.00.
Identifies the $14,250.00 American College of Cardiology Expo charge on Card 7003 (BILL-774) as a deposit for a March 2027 conference improperly expensed to 6110 Digital Marketing in September 2026.
Proposes reclassifying the $14,250.00 conference deposit by debiting 1350 Prepaid Expenses $14,250.00 and crediting 6110 Digital Marketing $14,250.00 (`vendor_payment_identity_and_prepaid_review`).
Computes total September 2026 P&L expense overstatement from the two one-sided Amex autopayments ($38,900.00) and the prepaid March 2027 booth deposit ($14,250.00) as $53,150.00.
Computes ending September 2026 2150 Amex Control liability after booking all $114,620.00 of statement charges and applying the $38,900.00 of ACH payments as $75,720.00.
